text:
3 rounds for time:
400 m run
15 air squats
Record one total completion time.

For time, 15-minute cap:
100 burpees. Record finish time, or reps completed at the cap.
For time: 50 wall balls. Time cap: 450 seconds. Record one completion time, or reps at cap.

AMRAP 12 minutes:
5 pull-ups, 10 push-ups, 15 air squats. Score completed rounds plus extra reps.
AMRAP 7 minutes: burpees. Score total reps completed.
AMRAP 10 minutes: 2-4-6-8 and so on of dumbbell snatches and box jumps. Score total reps; do not record rounds.
EMOM 10 minutes: 5 burpees and 5 kettlebell swings.
Every minute for 10 minutes perform max burpees for 40 seconds, rest 20 seconds. Enter ten separate rep scores, sum them for the result.
Back squat 5 sets of 3. Enter all five set loads in kilograms. Result is the heaviest set.
Find a 1-rep max deadlift. Record only your final heaviest successful load in pounds.
Bench press 5 sets of 5. Score your heaviest lift.
4 x 400 m run, rest 2 minutes between. Record four separate times; result is their sum.
3 x 500 m row. Rest 3 minutes between. Enter three times; score is the average time.
6 x 100 m sprint. Rest 90 seconds. Record six times and use the fastest time.
10-minute max calorie bike. Enter one total calorie score.
Row as far as possible in 6 minutes. Score total meters.
Farmer carry 2 x 53 lb kettlebells for 3 minutes. Score total feet traveled.
10-minute skill test: each pull-up earns 2 points and each push-up earns 1 point. Enter one total points score.
Complete a 60-second unbroken plank. Record pass if completed unbroken, otherwise fail.
For time: 21-15-9 thrusters and pull-ups. Rx thrusters 95/65 lb. Scaled thrusters 65/45 lb and ring rows. Record one total time.
For time: 30 clean and jerks at 135/95. Record one total time.
For time: 30 clean and jerks, 60/42.5 kg. Record one finish time.
AMRAP 8 minutes: burpees. Score total reps. Tiebreak is time to finish the first 30 reps; lower tiebreak time wins.
AMRAP 9 minutes: 3 power cleans and 7 burpees each round. Score rounds plus extra reps.
Part A: Find a max back squat, score load. Part B: AMRAP 8 minutes of burpees, score total reps.
Warm-up: easy 3-minute row and 10 air squats. Workout: For time, 50 burpees. Record only the workout completion time.
For time: 25 Quantum Moonwalks. Record one total time.
For time with a cap: 75 wall balls. Score time or reps at cap. The time cap value is not supplied.
3 rounds: 1 minute max push-ups, 1 minute rest. Enter three separate rep scores. Only the last round counts as the result.

For time: 20 burpees. Record one completion time.
